source_record.title: (Junior) Graphic Designer (m/f/d)
source_record.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Role
As a (Junior) Graphic Designer in our Licensing Team, you will work closely with Sales and Project Management to create effective, on-brand marketing and licensing materials. This is a great opportunity to build hands-on experience across print design, digital assets, brand implementation, and AI-supported design workflows.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Design and develop sales and licensing materials, including brochures, cover letters, order forms, certificates, and presentation assets

  • Create premium quality seals and award badges that reflect the credibility and high standards of our rankings

  • Handle layout, final artwork, file preparation, and the creation of print-ready PDFs

  • Edit and optimize images for print and digital use

  • Improve and further develop existing sales collateral using innovative design methods and AI-powered creative tools

  • Design merchandise and promotional materials, such as stickers, roll-ups, and additional point-of-sale assets

  • Ensure all materials align with corporate design guidelines and maintain a consistent visual brand identity

  • Collaborate closely with Project Management and Sales to develop targeted, effective, and visually engaging sales communications

 

Your Profile

  • You have completed vocational training or hold a degree in Graphic Design, Media Design, Communication Design, or a comparable creative field

  • You have a strong eye for design, typography, composition, color, and detail

  • You enjoy developing creative concepts and translating ideas into clear, high-quality visual communication

  • You are proficient in the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Adobe InDesign and Adobe Illustrator

  • You are curious about AI-based design tools and eager to explore how they can enhance creative workflows

  • You have initial experience with print products, prepress, print production, and corporate design implementation

  • You work in a structured, reliable, and organized way, with strong time-management skills

  • You communicate confidently in both German and English

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.
